items.title: [2026-07-13] List your property free — zero brokerage (Image Prompt)
items.content: Scene: a modern editorial real-estate poster for QckServe, India's free local marketplace, shot as a flat-lay hero for a rental-listing campaign. Subject: a young Indian property owner handing keys directly to a renter across a bright table, warm and candid, no broker present. Phone-UI mockup: a clean QckServe listing screen floating beside them showing a flat photo, the label 'Brokerage: ₹0', a 'List free' button, and 'owner-direct' badge — crisp, legible, realistic UI. Colour system: flat colour blocking only, NO gradients — deep charcoal #1A1A1A base, signature orange #FF6B00 / #ef6723 accent bands, soft off-white #FCF9F8 for breathing space; one accent used sparingly. Lighting: soft directional daylight, gentle shadows, editorial and premium, high key on the off-white zones. Type hierarchy: ONE oversized condensed headline 'LIST YOUR PROPERTY FREE', a giant ₹0 as the hero device, a small italic-serif kicker 'owner-direct, no middleman'. Eye flow: giant ₹0 → headline → phone UI → keys changing hands. Camera: 50mm, straight-on, shallow depth, product-photography sharpness. Performance layer: reserve the TOP-LEFT square as a clean empty logo zone (logo placed manually); keep bottom-left clear for 'qckserve.in'. --ar 4:5 --style raw --v 6.1
